assertion_independence: No assertion compares an echo-only supplied value as its sole regression oracle: head identity comparisons are supplemented by Git HEAD and source-marker reads; supplied peer SHAs are checked against independently constructed conflicting Git history; count assertions use observed calls or measurement outputs. The fixture gate test_interaction fails only for the independently passing alpha=1/beta=9 combination. pytest.raises checks guard exceptions and messages, and would redden if the respective refusal were removed. Restoring the old moved-primary refusal reddens both parametrized refresh cases as recorded by the negative control. The complete/dry-run doubles limit coverage of the real promotion layer; no test covers the newly conflicting queued group.

findings.text: blocking: A group queued cleanly can encounter a new primary conflict before it drains; build_merge_group raises MergeConflictError here without dispatch_merge_repair for the conflicting member, _complete_landing_group propagates it, and finish_landing_groups retries the same persisted heads, leaving the group stuck instead of returning the originating worktree for the repair round the plan requires; catch this case, identify and dispatch the affected member through the existing repair owner, and test a primary conflict introduced between queueing and draining.
